title: Xiamen Namate New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Xiamen Namate New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese aerogel manufacturer with a public English-language website dedicated to aerogel products and applications. The company presents a product line covering aerogel blankets, boards, pipe jackets, powder and granules, building insulation systems, and thermal-runaway protection solutions.

Company Overview

Namate positions itself as a dedicated aerogel materials supplier for industrial insulation, cryogenic systems, building envelopes, and battery safety. Its public website highlights standardized product families and application pages covering both high-temperature and deep-cold operating conditions.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China and international business development through an export-facing English website.
  • Focus Areas: High-temperature pipeline and equipment insulation, cryogenic pipeline systems, building insulation, and thermal-runaway protection.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel blankets for extreme-temperature, high-temperature, and cryogenic insulation
  • Aerogel board products
  • Aerogel pipe jackets
  • Aerogel Energy Shield systems
  • Aerogel powder and granules
  • IntegraGel building insulation systems
  • Public Capacity: A specific annual production figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed official pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Operating Base: Xiamen-linked operations in China, based on the company identity and contact presentation on the official site.
  • International Certifications: Specific international certification numbers are not clearly listed on the reviewed public pages.
  • Official Website: https://nmtaerogel.com/
